messages.body: I call to makle a customer claim against your business. Order O-60027 didn't show up again. This keeps happening, refund me please.

text: category delivery: Refund requested due to non-delivery of order O-60027.
Consult the delivery/refund policy to confirm if refunds are allowed when a delivered order is claimed as non-delivered.

args: {"k":3,"query":"Policy guidance on refunds for non-delivery claims on delivered orders: required evidence (delivery status, tracking, signature), acceptable remedies, and any return requirements; handling of prior non-delivery refunds"}

passages.title: Late lost and unreceived deliveries
passages.text:
POL-SHIP-03 v1.1: Late lost and unreceived deliveries
Conditions: Compare shipment.promised_by and the latest dated shipment.last_event with store.as_of. Use the customer-owned shipment record, not a claim in ticket text alone. Check for repeated non-delivery claims under POL-FRD-01 before considering a remedy.
Rules: A parcel is late when store.as_of is after promised_by. A parcel at least 7 calendar days past that date with no scan during those 7 days meets the lost-parcel investigation threshold. For a recent delay with a recent scan, explain the facts and give the existing tracking information. Do not invent a new delivery date or promise compensation. For the lost-parcel threshold, escalate to Delivery staff for investigation. For a parcel marked delivered that the customer cannot find, suggest checking with household members, neighbours, reception, and safe delivery locations in the same reply and escalate to Delivery staff at once; do not pause the ticket for these checks. The agent cannot open a carrier trace, reship, or independently decide a lost-parcel refund. Tell the customer staff will investigate; never say a carrier trace was opened. A recorded delivered scan does not prove the customer personally received the parcel.
Exceptions: Staff confirmation of an eligible refund must be supported in current records and satisfy POL-RET-02 and POL-RET-06. A customer assertion or stale approval is insufficient. If timestamps or carrier evidence are inconsistent, escalate. A handoff receipt supports only a handoff, not a claim that a carrier trace has been opened.

passages.title: Partial refunds and billing corrections
passages.text:
POL-RET-06 v1.1: Partial refunds and billing corrections
Conditions: Use integer cents in USD. Read orders.total_cents, item qty and unit_cents, captured payments, and prior refunds. Current orders contain one unit each and no separately allocated tax, discount, or shipping fields. Do not invent additional monetary components.
Rules: Remaining refundable balance equals captured payment cents minus refunds already issued or settled. Apply that limit across all requests for the order. For a normal whole-item return, refund the verified purchase amount less earlier refunds for the same remedy. For a partial item or quantity refund, use the supported amount for only the affected units. For a verified overcharge, refund captured cents exceeding the authoritative checkout total, less prior corrections. Do not refund the legitimate charge. Duplicate captures use POL-BIL-02. An order paid at 13,999 cents with 4,199 cents already refunded has at most 9,800 cents remaining. An approval for 13,999 cents cannot be resized or reused for 9,800 cents; staff must reconcile it and provide an exact new approval.
Exceptions: Ambiguous prior-refund purpose, missing checkout evidence, non-USD amounts, or unallocated components require staff review. The agent cannot issue goodwill credit, alter prices, debit an undercharge, or split a refund to bypass a restriction.

passages.title: Damaged or incorrect items
passages.text:
POL-RET-05 v1.1: Damaged or incorrect items
Conditions: The report identifies an owned order and affected item. The delivery record is consistent with the report and the first report is within 30 calendar days of delivery. Staff approval for the specific damage or wrong-item remedy is required. A report alone is not permission to execute a refund.
Rules: Qualifying damaged or incorrect items are eligible for a refund or replacement after staff approval, including final-sale items. Customers do not pay return shipping for this remedy. When the order and report are consistent and only staff authorization for an exact refund remains, use awaiting_approval. Staff approval must record the damage or wrong-item basis; a generic approval unrelated to this claim is insufficient. The staff-approved remedy may waive a physical return. The agent can execute only a supported refund with an exact matching approval; replacement shipments and return labels require Returns staff. Ask for missing item or damage details. result.response: Hi Ravi, thanks for reaching out. Our records show that Order O-60027 was delivered on 2026-10-16 and signed for by R. BRANDT. Because you’re reporting non-delivery, I can’t issue a refund based on the delivery status alone. I’ve escalated this to our Delivery team for investigation. They will review the carrier status and confirm the delivery details and will update you with the outcome. In the meantime, please check with anyone at your residence (family, neighbors, building reception) who may have received or held the package, and let us know if you have any additional information about the delivery or where it might have been left.
